title: TextVerifier: Seeing Beyond Recognition to Verify Chinese Text Rendering
title_zh: TextVerifier：超越识别，验证中文文本渲染

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image models increasingly generate readable Chinese text that still contains local rendering defects, such as a character with an extra or missing stroke or a malformed component. Such errors are invisible to OCR and vision–language models, which are trained for recognition and are therefore invariant to the very structural deviations that define a rendering error. We formalize text rendering verification as a target-conditioned problem: given a target character and an image crop, decide whether the crop is a correct rendering of that character. Our verifier TextVerifier feeds the text tower a character’s Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) rather than a single-character symbol, and is trained on 12.7 12.7 M crop–IDS pairs plus label-free “same-character, different-quality” hard pairs sampled from the training trajectory of a text-region inpainting model. To evaluate this ability we build TextRenderBench-ZH , the first per-character benchmark for generated Chinese text, annotating position, identity, and correctness for 7,358 7{,}358 characters. TextVerifier reaches an F1 of 0.844 0.844 , far above OCR confidence ( 0.526 0.526 ), a general VLM ( 0.329 0.329 ), and TextPecker ( 0.590 0.590 ). Used as a per-character reward for Flow-GRPO post-training, it further reduces rendering errors, showing that its score can both detect and correct errors.

paragraphs.en: Rendering text inside images has become a core capability of text-to-image models. Recent foundation models ( Wu et al., 2025 ; ByteDance Seed, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2026a ; Google DeepMind, 2026a ) render full sentences and even paragraphs of English and Chinese, and text rendering is now a key axis along which their quality is compared ( Li et al., 2026 ; Chang et al., 2025 ; Geng et al., 2025 ) . Even so, the strongest models still make rendering errors, and whether an error can be caught depends on the script: in English a wrong glyph changes the recognized word, so an OCR model flags it, whereas a malformed Chinese character is usually still read as the intended one and slips through. This asymmetry matters because Chinese, with six to eight thousand densely stroked characters built from components under hierarchical spatial structures ( Zhang et al., 2018 ; Cao et al., 2020 ) , fails not as an unreadable string but as a readable sentence with a single flawed character: a headline reads correctly at a glance, yet one character adds or drops a stroke, or malforms a component (Figure 1 ). In publishing, education, and other zero-tolerance settings, one such mistake can make an entire image unusable. Evaluating or correcting such a model therefore rests on a more basic ability: to automatically judge whether every Chinese character in a generated image is rendered correctly.

paragraphs.en: The most natural idea is to reuse a text recognizer, yet recognition and correctness verification pursue opposite objectives. OCR models are trained for content recovery: they read which character is present despite changes in font, style, deformation, and blur, and is thus deliberately invariant to a glyph’s visual variation. Verification demands the opposite: sensitivity to structural deviation, so that a glyph with an added or missing stroke, or a blurred component, stays distinguishable from the canonical form. PP-OCRv6 ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) illustrates the mismatch: it assigns confidence above 0.99 0.99 even to a clearly wrong character (Figure 1 ), so its confidence is a poor criterion for rendering correctness. Prompting a general vision-language model directly is no better: on our benchmark even the best-performing Gemini 3.7 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026b ) recalls only 54 % 54\% of the erroneous characters. Recognition models, in short, do not provide a reliable criterion for glyph correctness, which instead calls for a capability trained specifically for structural verification.
paragraphs.zh: 最自然的思路是复用文本识别器，但识别与正确性验证的目标却相互对立。 OCR 模型是为内容恢复而训练的：它们能够识别出存在哪些字符，即便字体、风格、形变和模糊发生变化，因此其设计刻意对字形的外观变化保持不变。 验证则要求相反的特性：对结构偏差保持敏感，这样即使某个字形多了一笔或少了一笔，或者某个部件变得模糊，仍然能够与标准形式区分开来。 PP-OCRv6（Zhang 等人，2026a）揭示了这种不匹配：它甚至会给一个明显错误的字符分配超过 0.99 的置信度（图 1），因此其置信度并非判断正确性的可靠标准。 直接提示通用视觉语言模型的效果也好不到哪里去：在我们的基准测试中，表现最佳的 Gemini 3.7 Flash（Google DeepMind，2026b）也仅能识别出 54% 的错误字符。 简而言之，识别模型无法提供可靠的字形正确性判断标准，而正确性验证需要专门针对结构验证进行训练的能力。

paragraphs.en: TextPecker ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) is the first work to address this problem in a systematic way, fine-tuning an 8B vision-language model as a structural-anomaly assessor. However, it folds blur, deformation, misalignment, and glyph error into a single notion of structural anomaly and judges an image without conditioning on the intended character. Lacking any model of which renderings of a character are legitimate, it readily flags correct characters as anomalies: on our benchmark it reaches a recall of 0.765 0.765 at a precision of only 0.480 0.480 (F1 0.590 0.590 ), producing a very high number of false alarms. Its 8B backbone also makes it costly to run at scale or to use as a training-time reward.
paragraphs.zh: TextPecker（Zhu 等人，2026）是首个系统性地解决该问题的研究，它将一个 8B 视觉语言模型微调为结构异常评估器。 然而，它将模糊、形变、错位和字形错误都归入单一的结构异常概念中，并且在未考虑预期字符的情况下对图像进行判断。 由于缺乏关于哪些字符渲染形式是合法的模型，它很容易将正确的字符标记为异常：在我们的基准测试中，当精确度仅为 0.480 时，其召回率达到 0.765（F1 为 0.590），导致误报数量极高。 其 8B 的骨干模型也使得大规模运行或将其用作训练时的奖励模型成本高昂。

paragraphs.en: We therefore formalize the task as target-conditioned text rendering verification . Given a target character c c supplied by a recognizer (e.g., an OCR model) and the corresponding image crop x x , the goal is to decide whether x x is a correct rendering of c c . This is naturally a conditional anomaly-detection problem: each character spans a manifold of legitimate renderings across fonts, calligraphy, and artistic styles, and an incorrect glyph lies a small distance off that manifold. Guided by this notion, we build TextVerifier , a CLIP-style dual-tower model ( Radford et al., 2021 ) whose text tower takes the Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) ( The Unicode Consortium, 2026 ) of a character rather than a single-character token. We assemble an automatic labeling pipeline that yields 12.7 12.7 M crop–IDS pairs from about 2.5 2.5 M real images for the first-stage alignment pretraining. For discriminative supervision, we construct a set of hard positive–negative pairs by two routes: manual synthesis, and mining “same-character, different-quality” pairs from the training trajectory of a text-region inpainting model. We then train the verifier to produce a continuous, calibrated, target-conditioned score for each character.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们将该任务形式化为以目标为条件的文本渲染验证。 给定由识别器（例如 OCR 模型）提供的目标字符 c c 和对应的图像裁剪区域 x x ，目标是判断 x x 是否为 c c 的正确渲染。 这本质上是一个条件异常检测问题：每个字符跨越了不同字体、书法和艺术风格中合法渲染构成的流形，而错误的字形则仅偏离该流形一小段距离。 基于这一理念，我们构建了 TextVerifier——一个 CLIP 风格的双塔模型（Radford et al., 2021），其文本塔采用字符的表意描述序列（IDS）（The Unicode Consortium, 2026），而非单个字符标记。 我们搭建了一条自动标注流程，从约 250 万张真实图像中生成 1270 万个裁剪–IDS 对，用于第一阶段的对齐预训练。 为了实现判别性监督，我们通过两种途径构建了一组困难的正负样本对：人工合成，以及从文本区域修复模型的训练轨迹中挖掘“相同字符、不同质量”的样本对。 接着，我们训练该验证器，使其为每个字符生成一个连续、经过校准且以目标为条件的得分。

paragraphs.en: We summarize our contributions as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We build TextVerifier , a structure-aware verifier that encodes each character’s IDS decomposition in a CLIP-style dual tower, reaching high accuracy at only 0.36 0.36 B parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 TextVerifier，这是一种结构感知验证器，它将每个字符的 IDS 分解编码为 CLIP 风格的双塔模型，在仅使用 0.36 0.36B 参数的情况下便实现了高精度。

paragraphs.en: We design a three-stage training curriculum and a label-free way to construct its supervision, combining synthetic positive–negative pairs with hard pairs mined from a text-region inpainting model’s training trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一个三阶段训练课程以及一种无标签的监督构建方法，该方法将合成的正负样本对与从文本区域图像修复模型训练轨迹中挖掘出的困难样本对相结合。

paragraphs.en: We build TextRenderBench-ZH , the first per-character benchmark for generated Chinese text verification, on which TextVerifier reaches an F1 of 0.844 0.844 at 7.6 7.6 ms per character, and show that it can serve as a per-character reward for Flow-GRPO training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 TextRenderBench-ZH——首个针对生成中文文本的逐字符验证基准。在该基准上，TextVerifier 的 F1 分数达到 0.844，每字符处理时间为 7.6 毫秒，并证明了其可用作 Flow-GRPO 训练的逐字符奖励。

paragraphs.en: Text recognition aims to recover which characters an image contains, spanning two-stage detect-then-recognize pipelines ( Baek et al., 2019 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , end-to-end vision-language parsers ( Wei et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Lu et al., 2026 ) , and general-purpose VLMs ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . Whatever the architecture, these models optimize recognition accuracy and are thus invariant to font, style, and degradation: a glyph with an added stroke is read as the same character with high confidence, and VLM-based systems further lean on a language prior that quietly corrects ill-formed inputs ( Liang et al., 2026b ; Tong et al., 2024 ) . We therefore separate recognition from verification: OCR supplies only the target character and its location, and correctness is left to a dedicated verifier trained for sensitivity rather than invariance.
paragraphs.zh: 文本识别旨在恢复图像中包含的字符，其方法涵盖两阶段“先检测后识别”的流程（Baek 等，2019；Zhang 等，2026a）、端到端的视觉-语言解析器（Wei 等，2024；Wei 等，2025；Zhang 等，2026b；Lu 等，2026）以及通用视觉语言模型（Qwen Team，2026）。 无论采用何种架构，这些模型都以识别准确率为目标进行优化，因此对字体、样式和图像退化具有不变性：一个添加了笔画的字符仍会被高置信度地识别为原字符，而基于视觉语言模型的系统还会进一步依赖语言先验知识，从而隐式地纠正结构不正确的输入（Liang 等，2026b；Tong 等，2024）。 因此，我们将识别与验证分离：OCR 仅输出目标字符及其位置，而正确性则由一个专门训练用于敏感检测而非不变性的独立验证器来判断。

paragraphs.en: Chinese characters decompose into many components under a small set of spatial structures, written linearly as an Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) ( The Unicode Consortium, 2026 ) . This compositionality drives zero-shot recognition through radical or stroke analysis ( Zhang et al., 2018 ; Cao et al., 2020 ) and, closest to us, CLIP-style image–IDS alignment for a canonical per-character representation ( Yu et al., 2023 ) . A related line checks whether a handwritten character is well formed, decoding an image into an IDS and flagging any mismatch with a known character ( Li et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2025a ; Sun et al., 2024 ) , recently extended to full text lines ( Li et al., 2024 ) . These target recognition or handwriting, where glyphs are clean and errors are whole-component swaps. Our setting differs on three counts. Generation errors are pixel-level rather than component-level: broken or adhered strokes and stylized fonts leave a glyph just off the manifold of valid renderings rather than turning it into a different character. The target character is already supplied by an upstream recognizer, so we verify a known identity instead of predicting it. And our supervision is label-free rather than hand-annotated.

paragraphs.en: Visual text rendering has progressed from glyph-conditioned control ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Tuo et al., 2024 ) to native rendering inside foundation models ( Wu et al., 2025 ; ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) , yet its evaluation still rests almost entirely on OCR string metrics over prompt-only benchmarks ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2025 ) , which misread stylized-but-correct text, are sensitive to segmentation, and are judged by VLMs that hallucinate correctness ( Hu et al., 2025b ; Liang et al., 2026a ) . Models of glyph quality are recent: TextPecker fine-tunes an 8B VLM for structural-anomaly detection ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , TIQA regresses perceptual quality while ignoring correctness ( Koltsov et al., 2026 ) , and Type-R detects typos by word-level OCR differencing ( Shimoda et al., 2025 ) ; none labels each generated character with position, identity, and correctness ( Li et al., 2024 ) . The same string-versus-glyph gap reappears in reward design for post-training ( Black et al., 2024 ; Wallace et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) : OCR-string rewards are cheap but blind to glyph form and easily gamed ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Qiao et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , whereas VLM-judge rewards spend a large-model forward pass per sample and return discrete verdicts ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) , and another line uses human-annotated region-level preferences ( Shuai et al., 2026 ) . Our verifier instead is target-conditioned, per-character, continuous, and calibrated, and complements rather than replaces the OCR semantic reward inside Flow-GRPO.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉文本渲染已从基于字形的控制（Yang et al., 2023；Tuo et al., 2024）发展为在基础模型内部进行原生渲染（Wu et al., 2025；ByteDance Seed, 2026），但其评估几乎完全依赖于仅基于提示的基准测试中的 OCR 字符串指标（Chen et al., 2023；Du et al., 2025）。这些指标会错误识别风格化但正确的文本，对分词敏感，且由会幻觉正确性的 VLM 进行判断（Hu et al., 2025b；Liang et al., 2026a）。 关于字形质量的模型是近期才出现的：TextPecker 针对结构异常检测对 8B VLM 进行了微调（Zhu et al., 2026）；TIQA 回归感知质量却忽略了正确性（Koltsov et al., 2026）；Type-R 则通过词级 OCR 差异检测错别字（Shimoda et al., 2025）。但这些模型均未为每个生成的字符标注位置、身份和正确性（Li et al., 2024）。 在训练后的奖励设计中，字符串与字形之间的相同鸿沟再次出现（Black et al., 2024；Wallace et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2025）：OCR 字符串奖励成本低廉，但对字形形式视而不见且容易被操纵（Liu et al., 2025；Qiao et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026）；而 VLM 评判奖励则需为每个样本执行一次大模型的前向传播并返回离散判断（Zhu et al., 2026；Cui et al., 2026），另一条路线则使用了人类标注的区域级偏好（Shuai et al., 2026）。 相比之下，我们的验证器是目标条件化的、逐字符的、连续的且经过校准的，它补充而非替代了 Flow-GRPO 中的 OCR 语义奖励。

paragraphs.en: We base the verifier on a CLIP-style dual tower ( Radford et al., 2021 ) but reshape its text side. Since the “text” here is only the target character itself, treating each character as an independent token would reduce the text tower to a class lookup table with no structural relation between characters. We instead feed it the character’s Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) ( The Unicode Consortium, 2026 ) : with a dozen structural operators and about a thousand components, an IDS writes each character uniquely as a sequence describing its components and structure (Figure 2 ), so that characters sharing components or structure lie close at the sequence level and structural differences can be encoded explicitly. The text tower adopts the CCR-CLIP ( Yu et al., 2023 ) decomposition table with a from-scratch DeBERTa ( He et al., 2021 ) ; the image tower is a ViT ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) whose patch tokens are averaged into the image feature. Each tower has an MLP projection head into a shared, ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized space, and the cross-modal match is the cosine sim ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( x ) , g ⁡ ( c ) ) \mathrm{sim}(f(x),g(c)) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的验证器基于一种 CLIP 风格的双塔结构（Radford et al., 2021），但对其文本侧进行了重新设计。 由于此处的“文本”仅指目标字符本身，若将每个字符视为独立的词元，则文本塔将退化为一个类查找表，字符之间不再具有结构性关联。 因此，我们转而输入该字符的表意描述序列（IDS）（The Unicode Consortium, 2026）：IDS 包含十余种结构算子和约一千个组件，能以唯一的方式将每个字符写成一个描述其组件与结构的序列（图 2），这样共享组件或结构的字符在序列层级上会更接近，而结构性差异也能被显式编码。 文本塔采用 CCR-CLIP（Yu et al., 2023）的分解表，并搭配从头训练的 DeBERTa（He et al., 2021）；图像塔则是一个 ViT（Dosovitskiy et al., 2021），其分块词元会被平均后整合为图像特征。 每个塔都包含一个 MLP 投影头，将输出映射到一个共享的、经过 ℓ₂-归一化的空间；跨模态匹配则通过余弦相似度 sim(f(x),g(c)) 计算。

sents.en: We base the verifier on a CLIP-style dual tower ( Radford et al., 2021 ) but reshape its text side.
sents.zh: 我们的验证器基于一种 CLIP 风格的双塔结构（Radford et al., 2021），但对其文本侧进行了重新设计。

sents.en: Since the “text” here is only the target character itself, treating each character as an independent token would reduce the text tower to a class lookup table with no structural relation between characters.
sents.zh: 由于此处的“文本”仅指目标字符本身，若将每个字符视为独立的词元，则文本塔将退化为一个类查找表，字符之间不再具有结构性关联。

sents.en: We instead feed it the character’s Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) ( The Unicode Consortium, 2026 ) : with a dozen structural operators and about a thousand components, an IDS writes each character uniquely as a sequence describing its components and structure (Figure 2 ), so that characters sharing components or structure lie close at the sequence level and structural differences can be encoded explicitly.
sents.zh: 因此，我们转而输入该字符的表意描述序列（IDS）（The Unicode Consortium, 2026）：IDS 包含十余种结构算子和约一千个组件，能以唯一的方式将每个字符写成一个描述其组件与结构的序列（图 2），这样共享组件或结构的字符在序列层级上会更接近，而结构性差异也能被显式编码。

sents.en: The text tower adopts the CCR-CLIP ( Yu et al., 2023 ) decomposition table with a from-scratch DeBERTa ( He et al., 2021 ) ; the image tower is a ViT ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) whose patch tokens are averaged into the image feature.
sents.zh: 文本塔采用 CCR-CLIP（Yu et al., 2023）的分解表，并搭配从头训练的 DeBERTa（He et al., 2021）；图像塔则是一个 ViT（Dosovitskiy et al., 2021），其分块词元会被平均后整合为图像特征。

sents.en: Each tower has an MLP projection head into a shared, ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized space, and the cross-modal match is the cosine sim ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( x ) , g ⁡ ( c ) ) \mathrm{sim}(f(x),g(c)) .
sents.zh: 每个塔都包含一个 MLP 投影头，将输出映射到一个共享的、经过 ℓ₂-归一化的空间；跨模态匹配则通过余弦相似度 sim(f(x),g(c)) 计算。

paragraphs.en: The verifier is trained in three stages over three kinds of data. The first stage teaches the model to distinguish the identities of different characters, using other characters in the same batch as negatives. With in-batch negatives, however, the model separates clearly different characters but cannot notice the fine stroke-level errors within a single character. The second and third stages therefore both introduce hard negatives for the same character, i.e., wrong renderings that closely resemble the correct glyph and differ only in small stroke or structural details; the two stages mainly differ in how these hard negatives are constructed, while also using different label semantics and loss forms. Figure 3 overviews the three-stage data construction.
paragraphs.zh: 验证器在三个阶段中，基于三种类型的数据进行训练。 第一阶段让模型学会区分不同字符的身份，使用同一批次中的其他字符作为负样本。 然而，在使用批次内负样本时，模型虽然能清晰区分不同字符，却无法察觉单个字符内部的细微笔画错误。 因此，第二阶段和第三阶段都引入了针对同一字符的困难负样本，即与正确字形高度相似、仅在细微笔画或结构细节上有所差异的错误渲染；这两个阶段的主要区别在于这些困难负样本的构建方式，同时它们也使用了不同的标签语义和损失函数形式。 图3概述了这三阶段的数据构建过程。

paragraphs.en: The first stage draws data from real images containing Chinese text, via an automatic pipeline of two off-the-shelf models: CRAFT ( Baek et al., 2019 ) is a character-level detector that locates each character and gives its bounding box, and PP-OCRv6 ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) then recognizes the crop in each box to obtain its target character. From about 2.5 2.5 M real images this yields over ten million crop–character pairs covering 8,189 8{,}189 characters. As character frequency is heavily long-tailed, we pad rare characters with font-rendered standard glyphs to at least 500 500 samples each, giving about 12.73 12.73 M crop–IDS pairs. Details are shown in Appendix A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段通过由两个现成模型组成的自动流程，从包含中文文本的真实图像中提取数据：CRAFT（Baek 等人，2019）是一种字符级检测器，能够定位每个字符并给出其边界框；随后，PP-OCRv6（Zhang 等人，2026a）则识别每个框内裁剪出的区域，以获取目标字符。 从约 250 万张真实图像中，这一流程生成了超过一千万个裁剪区域–字符对，覆盖了 8,189 个字符。 由于字符频率呈现明显的长尾分布，我们对低频字符使用字体渲染的标准字形进行填充，使每个字符至少达到 500 个样本，从而得到约 1273 万个裁剪区域–IDS 对。 详细信息见附录 A.2。

paragraphs.en: The second stage builds hard negatives by applying controlled perturbations to standard glyphs along two complementary routes. Font synthesis renders each character’s standard glyph in about thirty fonts and applies coarse perturbations: a missing stroke, which erases a segment of stroke pixels and fills it with background, or an added stroke, which overlays a horizontal, vertical, left-slanting, or right-slanting mark. The Makemeahanzi ( Kishore, 2016 ) dataset provides per-stroke vector paths for the kaiti font, supporting structurally precise whole-stroke edits such as deleting a full stroke or grafting one from another character into light contact with the ink. The two routes produce about 1.75 1.75 M glyph images; examples are shown in Appendix A.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段通过沿两条互补的路径对标准字形施加受控扰动，来构建困难负样本。 字体合成系统以约三十种字体渲染每个字符的标准字形，并施加粗略扰动：缺失笔画（擦除一段笔画像素并用背景填充）或添加笔画（叠加水平、垂直、左斜或右斜的标记）。 Makemeahanzi（Kishore, 2016）数据集为楷体字形的每一笔提供了矢量路径，支持结构精确的全笔画编辑，例如删除完整笔画，或将另一字符中的笔画嫁接至与墨迹轻微接触的位置。 这两条路径共产生了约 1.75 M 个字形图像；示例见附录 A.3。

paragraphs.en: The third stage builds negatives that more closely resemble real generation errors, which can only come from a generator itself. We exploit a convenient fact: a text-region inpainting model still in training leaves, along its trajectory, “same-character, different-quality” samples. For the same location and target character, its early checkpoints often render strokes wrongly while its late checkpoints are mostly correct, with texture, background, and color largely unchanged and only the glyph differing. We train such an inpainting model and use one early and one late checkpoint to repaint the same target character, yielding about 0.7 0.7 M pairs. The inpainting model’s architecture and further sample pairs are given in Appendix A.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 第三阶段构建的负样本更贴近真实的生成错误，而这些错误只能来自生成器本身。 我们利用了一个便利的事实：仍在训练中的文本区域修复模型会在其训练轨迹中留下“相同字符、不同质量”的样本。 对于同一位置和目标字符，其早期检查点常常错误地绘制笔画，而晚期检查点则基本正确，且纹理、背景和颜色大多未变，仅字形不同。 我们训练了这样一个修复模型，并使用一个早期检查点和一个晚期检查点重新绘制相同的目标字符，从而获得了约 0.7 百万对样本。 该修复模型的结构以及更多样本对见附录 A.4。

paragraphs.en: Existing text-rendering benchmarks provide only prompts and score whole images with OCR string metrics; they can neither judge glyph correctness character by character nor evaluate a verifier itself. We therefore build TextRenderBench-ZH , the first per-character benchmark of Chinese text rendering. Its test images are generated by text-to-image models: from 308 308 images we collect 7,358 7{,}358 character crops, 642 642 of them confirmed by human annotators as rendering errors. Each character carries a (position, identity, correctness) triple (Figure 4 ); Appendix E details the two-step annotation protocol and the error criterion. This is the first benchmark for generated images with per-Chinese-character triple annotation; it measures a verifier’s character-level precision and recall.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的文本渲染基准测试仅提供提示，并通过 OCR 字符串指标对整张图片进行评分；它们既无法逐字符判断字形是否正确，也无法评估验证器本身。 因此，我们构建了 TextRenderBench-ZH，这是首个针对中文文本渲染的逐字符基准测试。 其测试图像由文本到图像模型生成：我们从 308 张图像中收集了 7,358 个字符裁剪图，其中 642 个经人类标注员确认为渲染错误。 每个字符都带有（位置、身份、正确性）三元组（图 4）；附录 E 详细说明了分两步的标注流程以及错误判定标准。 这是首个对生成图像进行逐中文字符三元组标注的基准测试；它用于衡量验证器在字符层面的精确率和召回率。

paragraphs.en: A rendering error is the positive class and a correct glyph the negative in our benchmark, so a false positive (FP) is a false alarm on a correct glyph and a false negative (FN) a missed error. Baselines are PP-OCRv6 ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) character confidence (a glyph is flagged when its confidence falls below a threshold; we report an oracle best threshold as an upper reference), the general VLMs Qwen3.8-Max ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , GPT-5.6-sol ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , and Gemini 3.7 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026b ) , and the two released TextPecker ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) assessors.

Each term contributes to performance. Every ablation keeps recall near 0.86 0.86 but lowers precision markedly, confirming Sec. 3 : the ramp pairwise loss alone constrains neither the representation’s overall scale nor its cross-character separability, which are exactly what the replay and threshold losses supply.

paragraphs.en: We further use the verifier as a post-training reward. Starting from Qwen-Image ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , we post-train with Flow-GRPO ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , feeding R R to its reward interface( β = 10 − 3 \beta{=}10^{-3} , 20 20 denoising steps for rollout and training, otherwise default), and evaluate on oneID-ZH ( Chang et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: Our aim is to reduce glyph errors while disturbing the base generator as little as possible. Table 5 reports glyph accuracy (Glyph-Acc, the fraction of target characters our TextVerifier judges correctly rendered), diversity (DreamSim ( Fu et al., 2023 ) ), aesthetics (ImageReward ( Xu et al., 2023 ) ), and the reward model’s cost; Base (Qwen-Image ( Wu et al., 2025 ) ) is the un-post-trained reference, which trivially keeps the highest diversity and aesthetics but also all of its rendering errors. Two findings emerge. First, fixing glyphs requires a glyph-aware reward: a recognition-only reward (NED-only, dropping the glyph term G G ) barely lifts Glyph-Acc over Base ( → 0.822 0.812\!\to\!0.822 , Table 5 ), whereas the full reward reaches 0.915 0.915 . Second, against TextPecker ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , our reward attains comparable glyph accuracy ( 0.915 0.915 vs. 0.919 0.919 ) while perturbing diversity and aesthetics less ( 0.175 0.175 vs. 0.165 0.165 ; 0.633 0.633 vs. 0.629 0.629 ), with a 23 × 23\times smaller reward model ( 0.36 0.36 B vs. 8.29 8.29 B). Among methods that actually reduce rendering errors, then, ours is the least disruptive and the most efficient. Figure 5 shows qualitative comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是减少字形错误，同时尽可能少地干扰基础生成器。 表 5 报告了字形准确率（Glyph-Acc，即 TextVerifier 判定正确渲染的目标字符比例）、多样性（DreamSim (Fu et al., 2023)）、美学性（ImageReward (Xu et al., 2023)）以及奖励模型的成本；Base (Qwen-Image (Wu et al., 2025)) 是未经后训练的参考模型，它显然能保持最高的多样性和美学性，但也会保留所有渲染错误。由此得出两个发现。 首先，修复字形需要一个感知字形的奖励机制：仅基于识别的奖励（NED-only，即移除字形项 G G）几乎无法提升 Glyph-Acc 相对于 Base 的水平（→ 0.822 0.812\!\to\!0.822，表 5），而完整奖励则能达到 0.915 0.915。 其次，与 TextPecker (Zhu et al., 2026) 相比，我们的奖励模型在保持相当字形准确率（0.915 0.915 vs. 0.919 0.919）的同时，对多样性和美学性的扰动更小（0.175 0.175 vs. 0.165 0.165；0.633 0.633 vs. 0.629 0.629），且奖励模型规模小 23 倍（0.36 0.36 B vs. 8.29 8.29 B）。 因此，在真正能够减少渲染错误的方法中，我们的方法干扰最小、效率最高。 图 5 展示了定性对比结果。

paragraphs.en: We formalized Chinese text-rendering verification in generated images as target-conditioned anomaly detection, and built TextVerifier , an IDS-conditioned dual tower trained with a three-stage curriculum of cross-character alignment, synthetic absolute anchoring, and relative discrimination from an inpainting model’s trajectory. On TextRenderBench-ZH , it reaches 0.844 0.844 F1 at 7.6 7.6 ms per character. As a Flow-GRPO reward, it matches 8B-VLM rewards on error reduction while better preserving diversity and aesthetics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将生成图像中中文文本渲染的验证问题形式化为以目标为条件的异常检测任务，并构建了 TextVerifier——一个以 IDS 为条件的双塔模型，该模型通过包含跨字符对齐、合成绝对锚定以及基于图像修复模型轨迹的相对区分等三个阶段的课程进行训练。 在 TextRenderBench-ZH 上，其 F1 分数达到 0.844，每个字符的处理时间为 7.6 毫秒。 作为 Flow-GRPO 奖励函数，它在错误减少方面与 8B-VLM 奖励相当，同时能更好地保留多样性和美学效果。

paragraphs.en: Stage-2 pairs a character’s correct and incorrect renderings as absolute-label positives and negatives; negatives are synthesized by two complementary routes, about 1.75 1.75 M images in total. (i) Font synthesis : as shown in figure 6 , we render the standard glyph in 30 30 + fonts, then apply coarse perturbations—missing strokes (erase a stroke’s pixels, fill with background) and extra strokes (overlay one of a horizontal / vertical / left- / right-slanted stroke). (ii) Makemeahanzi synthesis ( Kishore, 2016 ) : this dataset gives per-stroke vector decompositions of the standard (kaiti) font, enabling semantically precise whole-stroke edits (delete a full stroke, or graft a stroke from another character and shift it into light contact with the target ink), i.e. finer-grained negatives. We illustrate the construction of these positive and negative samples in Figure 7 . Positives 𝒫 \mathcal{P} are font-correct renders, real crops, and the kaiti glyph; negatives 𝒩 \mathcal{N} are the synthesized errors. The Stage-1 InfoNCE ℒ r \mathcal{L}_{r} is replayed to preserve cross-character identity.

paragraphs.en: The Stage‑3 relative pairs are derived from the training trajectory of a text‑region inpainting model. Built upon the JiT ( Li and He, 2026 ) architecture (pixel‑space, VAE‑free; JiT‑H/16, ≈ 1 \approx 1 B params), the model concatenates three token groups along the sequence dimension: the full image (the region to be repainted is corrupted with Gaussian noise while the rest remains clean, serving as conditioning), target crops (the flow‑matching target outputs, of which there can be multiple), and the target character’s Qwen3‑0.6B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) embedding (frozen and used as conditioning). Its architectural design is illustrated in figure 8 . Following JiT ( Li and He, 2026 ) , it adopts the x‑prediction MSE loss to compute losses over target crop regions for training the flow‑matching model.
paragraphs.zh: 第3阶段的相对词对源自文本区域修复模型的训练轨迹。 该模型基于 JiT（Li 和 He，2026）架构（像素空间、无需 VAE；JiT-H/16，约 1 B 参数），沿序列维度拼接三个词元组：完整图像（待重绘区域被高斯噪声破坏，其余部分保持干净并作为条件输入）、目标裁剪块（流匹配的目标输出，可以有多个）以及目标字符的 Qwen3-0.6B（Yang 等，2025）嵌入向量（冻结并用作条件输入）。 其架构设计如图8所示。 与 JiT（Li 和 He，2026）一致，该模型采用 x-预测 MSE 损失，针对目标裁剪区域计算损失以训练流匹配模型。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, since the model is capable of structuring multiple target crops together with their corresponding character‑embedding prompts, we devise an attention mask as shown in figure 8 . This mask ensures that when computing self‑attention, each target crop can only attend to the full image, its own tokens, and its own embedding, and is prevented from attending to other crops. Furthermore, to inform the model of where each target crop is located within the full image, we modify 2D‑RoPE ( Heo et al., 2024 ) . We first introduce an additional n n dimension to distinguish the full image ( n = 0 n=0 ) from target crops ( n = 1 n=1 ). Second, we map both the full image and all target crops onto the absolute coordinate system of a large shared canvas to obtain the h h and w w coordinates for each patch, instead of taking the top‑left corner of each individual image as the origin of the relative coordinate system as in vanilla 2D‑RoPE ( Heo et al., 2024 ) . Accordingly, we supply the model with absolute position information for every patch of each target crop via 3D‑RoPE, so that the model can perceive their positions inside the full image.
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，由于该模型能够将多个目标作物与其对应的字符嵌入提示一同结构化，我们设计了图 8 所示的注意力掩码。 该掩码确保在计算自注意力时，每个目标作物只能关注完整图像、自身的词元以及自身的嵌入，而无法关注其他作物。 此外，为了告知模型每个目标作物在完整图像中的位置，我们对 2D-RoPE（Heo et al., 2024）进行了修改。 我们首先引入一个额外的 n 维维度，以区分完整图像（n = 0）和目标作物（n = 1）。 其次，我们将完整图像和所有目标作物都映射到一个大型共享画布的绝对坐标系中，从而获得每个区块的 h 和 w 坐标，而不是像传统 2D-RoPE（Heo et al., 2024）那样以每个独立图像的左上角作为相对坐标系的原点。 因此，我们通过 3D-RoPE 为模型提供每个目标作物中所有区块的绝对位置信息，使模型能够感知它们在完整图像中的位置。

paragraphs.en: To test whether the IDS tower organizes its text space by compositional structure, rather than merely benefiting from a smaller vocabulary, we encode the full 8,189 8{,}189 -character vocabulary with the Stage-3 IDS text tower and with the single-character-token tower of the otherwise identical checkpoint, and compare embedding geometry against symbolic structure. Using a fixed-seed, distance-stratified sample of 26,136 26{,}136 character pairs spanning five bins of normalized IDS token edit distance (flat Levenshtein on the IDS prefix), we correlate pair cosine with structural distance. The Spearman correlation is − 0.70 -0.70 for the IDS tower versus − 0.34 -0.34 for the single-character tower (95% character-cluster bootstrap CIs [ − 0.71 , − 0.70 ] [-0.71,-0.70] and [ − 0.35 , − 0.33 ] [-0.35,-0.33] ; difference − 0.36 -0.36 , CI [ − 0.37 , − 0.35 ] [-0.37,-0.35] ; paired permutation p < 10 − 3 p<10^{-3} ). Figure 11 (left) shows where the gap comes from: IDS-tower median cosine falls monotonically from 0.65 0.65 for near-identical decompositions to 0.05 0.05 for unrelated characters, while the single-character tower remains nearly flat ( 0.46 → 0.23 0.46\to 0.23 ), so structural proximity organizes only the IDS space. Stratifying by top-level composition operator (right), same-operator pairs embed markedly closer than different-operator ones for the IDS tower ( 0.25 0.25 vs. 0.12 0.12 ) but not for the single-character tower ( 0.28 0.28 vs. 0.24 0.24 ). Together with the detection results, this shows that the IDS tower’s advantage is accompanied by a structure-aligned representation, not merely a smaller output space.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验 IDS 塔是否依据组合结构来组织其文本空间，而不仅仅是受益于更小的词汇表，我们用 Stage-3 IDS 文本塔和来自其他完全相同检查点的单字符标记塔对完整的 8,189 个字符的词汇表进行编码，并比较嵌入几何与符号结构。 我们使用一个固定种子的、按距离分层的样本，包含 26,136 个字符对，这些字符对跨越了归一化 IDS 标记编辑距离（基于 IDS 前缀的平坦 Levenshtein 距离）的五个区间，并将字符对的余弦相似度与结构距离进行关联分析。 IDS 塔的斯皮尔曼相关系数为 −0.70，而单字符塔的相关系数为 −0.34（95% 字符簇自助置信区间为 [−0.71, −0.70] 和 [−0.35, −0.33]；差异为 −0.36，置信区间为 [−0.37, −0.35]；配对置换检验的 p 值 < 10⁻³）。 图 11（左）展示了这一差距的来源：对于几乎相同的分解结构，IDS 塔的中位数余弦相似度从 0.65 单调下降至无关字符时的 0.05，而单字符塔的余弦相似度则基本保持平稳（0.46 → 0.23），因此只有 IDS 空间是依据结构邻近性组织的。 按顶层组合算子分层分析（右图）显示，对于 IDS 塔，使用相同算子的字符对嵌入结果明显比不同算子更接近（0.25 vs. 0.12），但单字符塔则没有这种差异（0.28 vs. 0.24）。 结合检测结果表明，IDS 塔的优势不仅源于更小的输出空间，还伴随着一种与结构对齐的表示方式。

paragraphs.en: TextPecker ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) uses its own released evaluation protocol (crop-image input, structural anomalies flagged with special markers “ < # > <\#> ”); we run its two released weights (Qwen3-VL-8B and InternVL3-8B) as structural-anomaly assessors and refer to the original work for prompt details.
paragraphs.zh: TextPecker（Zhu 等人，2026）使用其自行发布的评估协议（以裁剪图像为输入，并通过特殊标记“< # > <\#>”标注结构异常）；我们运行其发布的两种权重模型（Qwen3-VL-8B 和 InternVL3-8B），用作结构异常评估器，具体提示细节请参见原始研究。

paragraphs.en: Annotation proceeds in two steps. A CRAFT ( Baek et al., 2019 ) + PP-OCRv6 ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) pipeline first proposes a bounding box and a character identity for each glyph; annotators then verify the box, confirm the identity, and label whether the glyph is correctly rendered, counting any stroke- or component-level deviation as an error while not penalizing font, calligraphic, or artistic style. Each character thereby receives its (position, identity, correctness) triple.
paragraphs.zh: 标注过程分为两个步骤。 一个由 CRAFT（Baek 等人，2019）和 PP-OCRv6（Zhang 等人，2026a）组成的流程首先为每个字形提出一个边界框和一个字符身份；随后，标注员会验证该边界框、确认字符身份，并标注该字形是否渲染正确，任何笔画或部件级别的偏差均计为错误，但字体、书法或艺术风格则不计入错误。 这样，每个字符便获得了其（位置、身份、正确性）三元组。
